_konstantopoulos2011.csv.name: _konstantopoulos2011.csv
_konstantopoulos2011.csv.note: a published dataset bundled with metafor; the column set matches that dataset exactly. Redistribution is governed by metafor's licence and the original publication, not by this repository

_nc_common_ref.csv.name: _nc_common_ref.csv
_nc_common_ref.csv.note: netmeta::netcontrib on Senn 2013, common effects: a 45 x 15 matrix of the weight each direct comparison carries in each network estimate. Reproduced by the script to 8.1e-14 with netmeta 3.7.0

_nc_random_ref.csv.name: _nc_random_ref.csv
_nc_random_ref.csv.note: netmeta::netcontrib on Senn 2013, random effects. Reproduced to 3.8e-15, and the estimator is pinned by that: with REML tau2 = 0.10105 and the matrix is off by 3.2e-3, with the default DL tau2 = 0.10872 and it agrees, which is also pimeta's default

_r_senn2013.tsv.name: _r_senn2013.tsv
_r_senn2013.tsv.note: output of the reference implementation, whose versions are recorded in the file's own header

_senn2013_comparison.csv.name: _senn2013_comparison.csv
_senn2013_comparison.csv.note: the Senn 2013 network in contrast format, as distributed with netmeta

dynhet.csv.name: dynhet.csv
dynhet.csv.note: simulated time-varying heterogeneity; the generating script fixes the seed, so the bytes are reproducible

dynhet_spline.csv.name: dynhet_spline.csv
dynhet_spline.csv.note: 60 studies whose between-study variance is a bump in the middle of the time range (0.050 at the ends, 0.246 at the centre), the shape a spline scale exists for; the generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes, and tools/r_reference/tau2t_spline.R refits the same model in Stan

ipd_nma.csv.name: ipd_nma.csv
ipd_nma.csv.note: simulated individual-patient network: eight studies of 180 participants per arm, two of them without treatment C so the network is incomplete but connected, correlated study-level arm effects and a common covariate slope. The generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes, and tools/r_reference/ipd_nma.R recomputes every pinned number with lme4

nma_bayes.csv.name: nma_bayes.csv
nma_bayes.csv.note: simulated arm-level network for the Bayesian NMA; checked against tools/quadrature_nma_bayes.py and multinma

nma_dose.csv.name: nma_dose.csv
nma_dose.csv.note: simulated dose-response network: two agents on separate Emax curves (1.4 / 30 and 0.9 / 25), study offsets and per-arm deviations with SD 0.22, three head-to-head contrasts at unequal doses. The generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes

nma_timecourse.csv.name: nma_timecourse.csv
nma_timecourse.csv.note: simulated repeated-measures network: one treatment per study on unbalanced schedules, AR(1) within-study errors (phi 0.6, SD 0.22) and between-study SD 0.18. The generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes

onestage_slopes.csv.name: onestage_slopes.csv
onestage_slopes.csv.note: 24 simulated studies of 165-275 participants with a correlated random intercept and treatment slope (D = [[0.09, 0.03], [0.03, 0.04]]) and residual SD 0.8; the generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes, and tools/r_reference/onestage_slopes.R recomputes every pinned number with lme4

prediction_joint.csv.name: prediction_joint.csv
prediction_joint.csv.note: 18 simulated accuracy studies with a C-statistic and a calibration slope; the generator fixes the seed and documents the data-generating process, and the reference numbers in tests/test_prediction_joint.py come from tools/r_reference/prediction_joint.R on exactly these bytes

robma.csv.name: robma.csv
robma.csv.note: simulated selection-model fixture used by the RoBMA and diagnostics tests

timecourse.csv.name: timecourse.csv
timecourse.csv.note: 16 simulated studies at 3, 6 and 12 months with a random intercept and slope and AR(1) within-study errors; the reference numbers come from tools/r_reference/timecourse.R

tvhr_piecewise.csv.name: tvhr_piecewise.csv
tvhr_piecewise.csv.note: 16 simulated studies of 400 participants with a hazard ratio that falls from exp(0.60) to exp(0) over 24 months; the generator fixes the seed and --check reproduces the bytes, and tools/r_reference/tvhr_piecewise.R recomputes every pinned number with glm and metafor::rma.mv
